title: Reserved-signal registry
description: Nonlexical signals that must never be admissible as motifs (calibration examples, READY cue, grammar clicks). The validator reports E_RESERVED when a candidate's pcm_sha256 equals an entry's, or when an entry has a recipe (same profile, or profile null) and the candidate is closer to it than the separation threshold. Hashes are recorded for the stated renderer_version.

renderer_version.description: Renderer version that produced every hash below.

profile.description: Profile the signal belongs to; null means it applies to every profile.

pcm_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the int16 LE sample bytes (renderer spec D9).

file_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical WAV file (renderer spec D8, D9).

recipe.description: Motif recipe when the signal is recipe-shaped, else null. Enables the feature-distance collision check.
